name: Matomo
description: Open source web analytics platform giving full control and ownership of visitor data.
longDescription:
Matomo (formerly Piwik) is a self-hosted, open-source web analytics platform positioned as a privacy-respecting alternative to Google Analytics. You install the PHP/MySQL application on your own server, add a small JavaScript snippet to the pages you want to track, and view visitor and traffic reports in real time from your own instance - keeping full ownership of the collected data rather than sending it to a third party.

According to the project, Matomo is used on more than 1.4 million websites. For teams that don't want to run their own server, Matomo Cloud offers a hosted version with a free trial as an alternative to self-hosting.

It suits organizations and developers who want web analytics with the same core reporting capabilities as mainstream analytics tools, but with the data staying on infrastructure they control.
